guidance: English-first short titles; render project counter and category in persistent chrome.
Do not render all metadata as video text. Title+one short action, large readable UI motifs.
Use each archetype's real visual grammar: tables for sheets, cards for kanban, nodes for workflows, split conversation for chat, axes for dashboards, distinct device frame for mobile.
Vary composition, palette, panel placement, data shape and motion direction between projects.
Numeric charts and records must remain visibly illustrative; avoid implying verified business improvements.
Demo sequences tell input-to-process-to-output stories; speed does not replace coherent state transitions.
Preserve website lecture film placeholders. These assets cover demo/project only.

Use each scene content.bullets, labels, stages and metrics in the UI; do not replace 144 concepts with identical placeholder text. Timeline means planning lanes outside creative editing; architecture in design means spatial form or scene composition.
